Here's a short, professional apology email template you can adapt:

**Subject:** Apology / [Brief context, e.g., "Missed deadline" or "Yesterday's meeting"]

Hi [Name],

I want to apologize for [specific issue — e.g., missing our 2 PM deadline / my tone in yesterday's stand-up / not reviewing the doc before the call]. It was [unprofessional / avoidable / my mistake], and I appreciate your patience.

Going forward, I'll [concrete step — e.g., set an earlier internal deadline / flag blockers sooner / review materials 30 min before meetings].

Thanks for calling it out — I value our working relationship and will do better.

Best,  
[Your name]

---

**Tips:** Keep it specific, own it fully (no "if I offended"), and include one clear corrective action.

PLAN: Provide the email template above with placeholders for the user to customize.
